query:
SELECT 
  att.id,
  att.scheduledDate,
  att.status,
  att.notes,
  att.createdAt,
  YEAR(att.scheduledDate) as year,
  MONTH(att.scheduledDate) as month
FROM attendance att
JOIN patients p ON att.patientId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Antonella%Salles%'
ORDER BY att.scheduledDate DESC;
